title: Jerusalem Bliss Flatbread
description: A simple flatbread infused with the flavors of Jerusalem and topped with a tangy bliss sauce.

ingredients.name: Jerusalem flour
ingredients.notes: You can substitute with regular flour if needed.

ingredients.name: Ferment
ingredients.notes: Active dry yeast or fermented flour can be used.

instructions: In a large bowl, combine Jerusalem flour, salt, and ferment.
Gradually add water and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until smooth.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Divide the dough into 2-3 equal portions, depending on desired flatbread size.
Roll out each portion into a thin circle.
Brush with olive oil and cook for 1-2 minutes on each side.
Transfer the flatbreads to a serving plate.
Drizzle with bliss sauce and garnish with fresh parsley.
